prompt_template.WHAT: A location art plate of a post-apocalyptic interior / exterior. Gameplay-functional, NOT a concept-art poster.
prompt_template.STYLE: 2D painted survival environments, dry-gouache. ASHFALL palette. Architectural geometry first, decoration second.
prompt_template.COMPOSITION: Architectural layout readable at a glance. ~15% margin at top + bottom for UI overlay. Negative space preserved.
prompt_template.CAMERA: Eye-level human-equivalent (~130 cm). NEVER aerial/drone. NEVER extreme wide-angle.
prompt_template.LIGHTING: Diffuse overcast by default. Strong directional only with documented reason. Soft shadow.
prompt_template.PALETTE: charcoal #2A2A2C, concrete grey #5C5F62, faded blue-grey #708085, rust brown #6E4A2F, dirty bone #B5A88A. Accents limited to muted amber #A26E2C (1-2% of pixels) and subtle cyan-green #4F7461 only for contamination iconography.
prompt_template.MATERIALS: Concrete grey walls, scrubby bent metal, rusted I-beams, frosted-pane windows, condensation drips. Functional decay.
prompt_template.BACKGROUND: Limited depth — the location is legible in foreground / mid / background. No endless horizon.
prompt_template.RUNTIME_READABILITY: 16:9 crop usable for expedition panel. Reads at 512×256 in-game. Negative-space margins preserved.
prompt_template.NEGATIVE: no real-world text, letters, or numerals; no logos or watermark; no AI signature glyphs; no anime-style eyes outside portrait family; no fantasy ornament or fleurons; no neon cyberpunk glow borders; no glossy 3D chromatic rendering; no crystalline particles; no stock-photo backdrop; no pristine factory-fresh finish on tools or weapons; no gratuitous gore; no real-country flags; no real brand marks. No rendered UI text — that is authored in Godot.
